dedupe_keys.name: geoportal del sector forestal de honduras icf forest cover maps 2014 to 2024 protected areas fire susceptibility and deforestation alerts

description: The forest sector geoportal of Honduras is the national map service of the Institute for Forest Conservation (ICF). The viewer read on 2026-09-28 lists official ICF layers with their file sizes: the national forest cover maps of 2024 (130 MB), 2018 (119 MB) and 2014 (316 MB), and maps of coffee and oil palm plantations in 2020; further layers cover community forest management contracts, protected areas, administrative divisions, cartography and infrastructure, forest management units, watersheds, public forest heritage, indigenous land titles, forest fire susceptibility and deforestation alerts, over OpenStreetMap and a digital terrain model. Coverage is national. Access is free in the viewer, with a login for registered users; the licence of the layers is not stated. Caveats: the download routes were not tested, forest maps are classifications with their own accuracy, and the infrastructure layer's content was not opened. It supports land cover and wildfire hazard exposure studies of roads, power lines and settlements in Honduras. Related record: data-copeco-honduras-geonode holds national flood and risk layers that complement it.
